https://ado-dokidokihimitsukichi-daigaku.title: Venue Report! April 27(Sat), 28(Sun) Ado SPECIAL LIVE "Heart" at National Stadium
text: Photos of Ado SPECIAL LIVE "Heart" held on April 27 (Sat.) and 28 (Sun.), 2024, at the National Stadium, including "Ado's Waku Waku Grand Plaza" (in front of the Seitoku Memorial Picture Gallery) and around the National Stadium, are now available for viewing. The earliest report of Ado SPECIAL LIVE "Heart" will be updated later. Please be forewarned that the first report of Ado SPECIAL LIVE "Heart" will be updated at a later date.
On April 27 (Sat.), the performance was held in the midst of unstable weather, with rain falling during the week of the event.
It rained a little in the morning, and many visitors were wearing umbrellas and coats, but the rain stopped before noon, and the overcast weather managed to hold out all day.
The night was so clear that a full moon could be seen, and it seemed as if the power of everyone who had gathered there was helping the weather to recover.
April 28th (Sunday) was sunny from the morning. It was a hot day all day long, but many visitors came to "Ado's Wakuwaku Grand Plaza" and the National Stadium.

■This year's "Heart" event, "Ado's Wakuwaku Grand Plaza" featured many firsts for Ado's LIVE. The venue was very crowded on both days, with a large number of visitors gathering prior to the early morning opening on both days.
◼️ First up was the merchandise area. The merchandise sales area was the largest ever held in the history of Ado's LIVE.

Many customers were examining the various goods and T-shirts that were actually on display, and many of them purchased them. In addition to the goods sold in advance, the "Fashionable 'Heart' T-shirt-o" was sold additionally, and many customers changed their clothes after purchasing it. Also, "Dokodemo Ado" and "Teeth Teru Teru Bohzu with Sunny" were worn or attached to bags by many customers, which was very impressive.
In addition, there were many customers who purchased a great number of goods in one account, so there were many shoppers with shoppers.

◼️The "Ado Gacha" was very popular on both days. Many people played the gacha five times in a row, and it was evident that friends, family members, and others were happy together every time they opened a capsule that they had played in the gacha.

The "Ado's Doki-Doki Secret Base" booth was also very busy. This time, Ado's fortune was in the style of Senja-fuda, commemorating the performance of "Heart," and it was impressive to see the smiles on the faces of all participants, young and old, men and women, as well as those living abroad, when they read the text of the fortune that Ado had thought up.
It was also very impressive that many people received special coasters for the "Heart" performance with smiles on their faces and took selfies with them as soon as they received them.
■For the first time at Ado's LIVE, a long-sought-after food and beverage booth, "Ado's Doki Doki Kitchen Car," made its debut.
Many customers were intrigued by the menu, which Ado had thought of entirely, and a long line of customers quickly formed.

Many people took pictures of the FoodMenu and ate with their friends, while many people strolled around the DrinkMenu drinking here and there in the hall. Many people were also wearing "Pad Thai stickers" on their sides.
Will there be more "Ado's Doki Doki Kitchen Car" in the future...?

■At the CD sales booth, we were accepting reservations for Ado's long-awaited second original album "Zanmu," which will be released on July 10, and since a hologram sticker will be given away as a reservation bonus only at this venue, many interested customers gathered there.

The huge photo spot area next to the entrance of "Ado's Waku Waku Grand Plaza" was filled with visitors taking commemorative photos every day. It was impressive to see people taking pictures in various poses from early in the morning until late at night. Thank you very much for your cooperation in taking pictures while keeping your turn.
And the National Stadium...

On both days, people gradually started heading toward the National Stadium before the doors opened at 4:00 p.m., and as the 6:00 p.m. start time approached, the circle of those gathered gradually grew larger and larger.

We also saw many people taking pictures with the key visual of this SPECIAL LIVE "Heart" in the background or taking pictures of the key visual, which was located on the perimeter of the National Stadium.
After the performance, many people were so excited that they left the venue, took commemorative photos, and headed to "Ado's Wakuwaku Grand Square" to purchase goods they had not yet purchased.
■Thank you very much for coming to Ado SPECIAL LIVE "Heart" this time.
